payload.claim: The comment above the `unread` field says 'a blocker a readable turn never answered', but that is the definition of `unanswered` (a readable turn skipped it). The comment above `unanswered` two lines later says 'a blocker standing after an unread turn', which is the definition of `unread` (the turn itself could not be read, per `rebut.unread_blockers`/`blocker_answers`). The two explanatory comments are swapped between the fields they sit on, so whoever reads this dataclass to learn what each count means is told the opposite of what the code computes.
